description: This file is an HTML webpage that serves as a user interface for visualizing and browsing databases, tables, and data fetched from a backend API. It includes styling, layout, and client-side JavaScript logic for dynamic content updates.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar menu.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles display of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table from fetched records.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for each cell, handling objects, nulls, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to reveal full data.
